items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: During that period I met also Bojangles.

ctx.x: One of the greatest acts on - I'll tell you, during that period you know how prejudiced they were. They wouldn't dare have a black person on Keith, Pantages, that. But Seymour and Jeanette were the only black team on Keith circuit, Pantages, and all - and Bill Bojangles. They only booked those two people. So John Williams received a wire that they needed a combo because Seymour did a strutting act and what not. He was very good at it but he had a bad heart, so he thought that if he got a small combo that would…
